title: Wendell and the Alibi
author: Ulyana Thornbury
blurb: Silas Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
